title: RDFR-CI: Reference Implementation, Scenario Library and Evaluation Harness
description: Version 1.4.1 is the release for the fourth revision of the RDFR-CI article. It adds the corrected HAI 21.03 labeled-attack evaluation (experiments/hai_evaluation.py), the replication on HAI 22.04 and 23.05 (experiments/hai_replication.py), the BATADAL (C-Town) second-system evaluation under a protocol and predictions fixed before analysis (experiments/batadal_evaluation.py, preregistration/batadal_ctown/), and the C-Town action-consequence simulation with WNTR (experiments/ctown_consequence.py). The policy implementation is unchanged from v1.3.0. No dataset is redistributed: raw SWaT, HAI and BATADAL files must be obtained from their providers; input-file hashes are stored in the results. Labeled SWaT A1/A2 attack performance is not claimed.
notes: ARTICLE DOI: pending. RDFR-CI v1.4.1 ZENODO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23277893. Earlier releases: v1.3.0 10.5281/zenodo.22682447; v1.2.1 10.5281/zenodo.22662284.
